messages:
katy: Morning — quick async standup for the gateway side. What I did: merged PR #1287 (header-based route matching) and ran a small eu-west canary. Blockers: seeing a tiny spike of 429s during short bursts (~0.4-0.6% when client rps >120). Today: opening PR to tweak ratepolicy thresholds and would like a review + someone to pair on auth header rotation tests. ping @sam @maria :wave:

pranav: nice work on the header routing. I'll take a look at your PR after breakfast. For the 429s, can you drop the relevant gateway logs and the ratepolicy snippet?

katy: logs (cut):
```
2026-03-16T09:12:33Z gw-1 WARN rate_limiter: allow=false client_id=svc-foo token_count=0 burst_used=121 policy=rb_60_20
2026-03-16T09:12:33Z gw-1 INFO route_eval: matched_rule=header-x-version target=svc-bar
```
ratepolicy snippet: `rb_60_20` -> burst=20, refill=60/min (default). Thinking the burst window is too small for short spikes from our dedicated pools.

sam: interesting — could be both burst size and a cold KV cache causing small head-of-line delays. If the first few requests are slower, token refill might not recover fast enough. I can review the ratepolicy PR and run a quick local replay against the canary config.

maria: I can pair on the auth header rotation tests this afternoon. FYI I saw a flaky auth-integration test earlier (token expiry path). Might be related if we hit the backend slower during bursts.

katy: thanks — tagging tasks: 1) @sam review PR #1294 (ratepolicy tweak) 2) @pranav sanity-check the logs for KV warmup patterns 3) @maria pair on auth tests ~ 2pm. Also I added an experiment flag to let the gateway use a slightly higher burst for dedicated customers (config key: `gw.experimental.dedicated_burst_boost`).

pranav: quick note — I pulled the traces and there's a cluster of ~70ms backend prep spikes at the same time as the 429s. Looks like warmup. Link: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/shared/abc123 (will post exact panel in PR).

sam: starting the PR review now. Two quick asks: add a unit for ratepolicy deserialization and a small e2e in staging that replays ramped bursts. Otherwise :+1:.

katy: added the unit test and a replay script under `infra/tests/replay_burst.sh`. Reproduces locally with `make replay BURST=140`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled a small staging deploy for branch/katy/ratepolicy-tweak at 2026-03-16T15:05:00Z — runbook: /runbooks/gateway-ratepolicy.md

maria: I can join the staging replay at 15:10 and validate auth flows. If ok, we can promote to canary.

katy: perfect. Blocker status: reduced (investigating config + tests). Will update after the staging run. Thanks all. :rocket:

ops-bot: FYI alerting tweak pushed: `gateway.429_rate.alert` threshold bumped to 1% for dedicated pools temporarily during experiment window (2026-03-16 14:50 -> 2026-03-18 14:50).

sam: noted. I'll hold review comments short so we can land and iterate.

pranav: if anyone needs me for the replay, ping in #eng-platform and I'll join the run.

katy: cool — closing this async thread, will post results and a link to the staged run in a follow-up.
